title: Sekani language
description: Athabaskan language of British Columbia, Canada
extract: Sekani or Tse’khene is a Northern Athabaskan language spoken by 135 of the Sekani people of north-central British Columbia, Canada. Most of them are only semispeakers, and it is considered critically endangered.
